title: 第12章 他编撰《淮南子》，其学识，足以比肩先秦诸子！
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
长安，未央宫。

    汉武帝刘彻，正站在一张巨大的地图前。

    地图上，详细地标注着大汉王朝的每一寸疆土，以及，疆土之外，那广袤的未知世界。

    他的目光，落在了北方。

    那里，是匈奴人的草原。

    这些年来，靠着卫青，靠着霍去病，靠着淮南王刘安献上的百炼钢锻造之法和全新的马鞍、马镫，大汉的铁骑，已经数次深入漠北，打得匈奴人狼狈逃窜，不敢南下牧马。

    “封狼居胥，禅于姑衍，饮马瀚海……”

    刘彻口中喃喃自语，眼中燃烧着熊熊的野心之火。

    他要做的，是超越历代先祖，甚至超越那位始皇帝的，不世之功！

    就在这时，一名宦官碎步走了进来，跪倒在地，声音带着颤抖。

    “陛下，淮南国八百里加急奏报！”

    “淮南？”

    刘彻眉头一挑，转过身来，“皇叔又有什么新奇的玩意儿送来了？”

    在他的印象里，自己这位叔叔，虽然不务正业，整天沉迷于炼丹修仙，但总能搞出一些让他惊喜的东西。

    无论是那让无数文人墨客为之疯狂的“淮南纸”，还是足以改变战争形态的百炼钢，都出自这位皇叔之手。

    刘彻甚至有时候会觉得，这位皇叔，根本不凡人，倒个无所不知的……

    神仙。

    然而，宦官接下来的话，却让他脸上的笑意，瞬间凝固。

    “回……回陛下，奏报上说……淮南王刘安，于三日前，因误服丹药……薨了！”

    “你说什么？！”

    刘彻的声音，瞬间提高八度，恐怖的帝王威压，轰然爆发。

    整个大殿的空气，都凝固了。

    那名宦官吓得魂飞魄散，将头死死地埋在地上，颤抖着重复道：“淮南王……薨了。”

    刘彻一把从他手中夺过那卷盖着淮南国相大印的奏报，迅速地扫了一遍。

    奏报上的内容，写得清清楚楚，明明白白。

    时间，地点，死因。

    一切，都无懈可击。

    甚至，连淮南王临死前，如何挣扎，如何后悔，都描述得绘声绘色。

    刘彻看完了奏报，脸上却没有任何悲伤的表情。

    他只是站在原地，一言不发，眼神变幻不定。

    大殿内，死的寂静。

    过了许久，他才缓缓地开口，声音冰冷得不带感情。

    “死了？”

    “误服丹药，中毒而死？”

    “呵呵……”

    他忽然发出了一声冷笑。

    那笑声，让下方的宦官，感觉自己坠入了冰窟。

    “你们，都信吗？”

    刘彻的目光，扫过大殿内侍立的几名近臣。
content_en:
Chang'an, Weiyang Palace.

    Liu Che, Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty, was standing in front of a huge map.

    On the map, every inch of the territory of the Han Dynasty was marked in detail, as well as the vast unknown world beyond the territory.

    His eyes fell on the north.

    There is the grassland of the Huns.

    Over the years, relying on Wei Qing, relying on Huo Qubing, and relying on the hundreds of steel forging methods and brand-new saddles and stirrups presented by Huainan King Liu An, the Han's iron cavalry has penetrated into Mobei several times, beating the Huns to flee in embarrassment and not daring to go south to herd horses.

    "Seal the wolf to live in Xu, meditate in Guyan, drink from the vast sea of horses..."

    Liu Che murmured to himself, his eyes burning with the fire of ambition.

    What he wants to do is to surpass the ancestors of all generations, and even surpass the first emperor, with unparalleled achievements!

    At this moment, a eunuch walked in slowly, knelt on the ground, his voice was trembling.

    "Your Majesty, please report urgently from eight hundred miles away from Huainan Kingdom!"

    "Huainan?"

    Liu Che raised his brows and turned around, "What new gadgets has the emperor sent you?"

    In his impression, although his uncle did not do his job properly and was obsessed with alchemy and immortality all day long, he could always come up with something that surprised him.

    Whether it was the "Huainan Paper" that made countless literati go crazy, or the Bailiang Steel that could change the shape of war, they were all made by this imperial uncle.

    Liu Che even sometimes felt that this imperial uncle was not an ordinary person at all, but an omniscient person...

    Immortal.

    However, the eunuch's next words made the smile on his face freeze instantly.

    "Return...back to Your Majesty, the report says...Huainan King Liu An died three days ago due to mistakenly taking the elixir!"

    "What did you say?!"

    Liu Che's voice instantly rose an octave, and the terrifying imperial pressure suddenly erupted.

    The air in the entire hall was frozen.

    The eunuch was so frightened that he buried his head on the ground and repeated tremblingly: "The King of Huainan... has passed away."

    Liu Che snatched the scroll with the seal of Huainan Prime Minister from his hand and scanned it quickly.

    The contents of the memorial were written clearly and clearly.

    Time, place, cause of death.

    Everything is impeccable.

    Even how King Huainan struggled and regretted before his death was vividly described.

    Liu Che finished reading the report, but there was no sad expression on his face.

    He just stood there, saying nothing, his eyes changing.

    In the main hall, there was deathly silence.

    After a long time, he spoke slowly, his voice cold and emotionless.

    "Dead?"

    "Did you accidentally take the elixir and die of poisoning?"

    "Haha..."

    He suddenly sneered.

    That laughter made the eunuch below feel like he had fallen into an ice cave.

    "Do you all believe it?"

    Liu Che's eyes swept across the several ministers standing in the hall.
